say:1:1033705001:1.text: Kilark thinks Rainford was ground zero for the corrupted roots, so they could be anywhere by now.
say:1:1033705001:1.source_cn: 奇克拉克判断沐霖村是第一个出现腐化根茎的地方。所以不管...
say:1:1033705001:1.male: Kilark thinks Rainford was ground zero for the corrupted roots, so they could be anywhere by now.
say:1:1033705001:1.female: Kilark thinks Rainford was ground zero for the corrupted roots, so they could be anywhere by now.

say:2:1033705002:1.text: I wouldn't be surprised if they made it as far as the Vaduso Mountains, or even beyond the forest.
say:2:1033705002:1.source_cn: 就算他们逃往瓦度索山脉，甚至丛林外，我都不会惊讶。
say:2:1033705002:1.male: I wouldn't be surprised if they made it as far as the Vaduso Mountains, or even beyond the forest.
say:2:1033705002:1.female: I wouldn't be surprised if they made it as far as the Vaduso Mountains, or even beyond the forest.

say:3:1033705003:1.text: I just hope they catch wind of our message and make it back safe and sound.
say:3:1033705003:1.source_cn: 现在只希望他们能早日接收到消息，回归家乡。
say:3:1033705003:1.male: I just hope they catch wind of our message and make it back safe and sound.
say:3:1033705003:1.female: I just hope they catch wind of our message and make it back safe and sound.
